en.summary: Rory McIlroy's probability of winning the 2026 Masters increased by 1.5% to 8%. This change follows recent headlines about Matt Fitzpatrick's confidence boost after winning the Valspar Championship, which may positively influence Rory's performance outlook.
drivers: Matt Fitzpatrick's Valspar Championship win
Increased confidence among top golfers
Speculation on Tiger Woods' participation
en.why_matters: Rory's rising odds reflect shifting dynamics in the golf world, potentially impacting betting strategies leading up to the Masters.

顶级高尔夫球手信心提升

zh.why_matters: 罗里的胜算上升反映了高尔夫界动态的变化，可能影响到大师赛前的投注策略。

market.question: Will the next Prime Minister of Hungary be László Toroczkai?

en.title: Toroczkai's Chances Diminish
en.summary: The probability of László Toroczkai becoming Prime Minister fell to 1% after Trump's endorsement of Orbán. This endorsement strengthens Orbán's position, reducing Toroczkai's chances.
drivers: Trump endorses Orbán, boosting his support
Orbán's anti-Ukraine stance consolidates power
Russian interference rumors favor incumbent
en.why_matters: The political landscape in Hungary is heavily influenced by external endorsements, which can significantly impact election outcomes.

zh.title: 托罗茨凯的机会减少
zh.summary: 在特朗普支持欧尔班后，托罗茨凯成为总理的概率降至1%。这一支持增强了欧尔班的地位，降低了托罗茨凯的机会。
drivers: 特朗普支持欧尔班，增强其支持
欧尔班的反乌克兰立场巩固权力
俄罗斯干预传闻有利于现任者
